answer: Give every agent a reputation score that decays unless it keeps doing verifiable work. A new wallet starts on a velvet ledge: soft landing, but one slip from falling off. Each completed task thickens the floor under it. A prism check then splits that score into separate traits like task quality and peer vouches, so a farm that games one trait still reads thin on the rest. Cloning an identity copies the name while the earned standing stays behind, and buying a dozen wallets buys a dozen thin ledges.
